description: This file defines the ConditionInterface, an interface for building and managing conditional clauses in database queries within Drupal's core database API.

classes.name: ConditionInterface
classes.description: Interface for a conditional clause in a database query, providing methods for building, combining, and compiling query conditions.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Builds a conditional clause with 1 to 3 parameters, supporting various operators and nested conditions.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Adds an arbitrary WHERE clause snippet with arguments.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Sets a condition that a field or subquery is NULL.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Sets a condition that a field or subquery is NOT NULL.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Sets a condition that a subquery returns results.

methods.name: notExists
methods.description: Sets a condition that a subquery returns no results.

methods.name: alwaysFalse
methods.description: Sets a condition that is always false.

methods.name: conditions
methods.description: Returns the list of nested conditions, modifiable by reference.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Retrieves all placeholders and values for prepared statements.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Prepares the condition data for retrieval, given a database connection and optional query placeholder.

methods.name: compiled
methods.description: Checks if the condition has been previously compiled.

methods.name: conditionGroupFactory
methods.description: Creates a group of conditions with specified conjunction (AND/OR).

methods.name: andConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group of conditions ANDed together.

methods.name: orConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group of conditions ORed together.
